supported_precision.formula: correctly predicted supported claims / all predicted supported claims

supported_recall.formula: expected supported claims predicted supported / all expected supported claims

unsupported_escape_rate.formula: expected non-supported claims predicted supported / all expected non-supported claims

citation_location_rate.formula: correctly matched expected spans / all expected spans

schema_success_rate.formula: valid outputs after zero or one repair / all generation attempts

scoring_rules.supported_only: Only status=supported counts as supported. partial, contradicted, unsupported, uncited, and abstained never count as supported.
scoring_rules.abstention: An abstention for an expected supported claim is a recall false negative.
scoring_rules.zero_denominator: Emit JSON null, label not_applicable, and exclude from macro aggregation.
